versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-cloudrobo-r2c skill.
- Provides commands to run the R2C (Robot-to-Cloud) data-plane edge client for secure robot-cloud bridging using Zenoh with mTLS authentication.
- Supports launching with credential bundle and custom robot hardware adapter configuration.
- Covers built-in adapter usage, dry-run testing, and guides for custom adapter development.
- Does not cover robot registration or credential export (see the robot skill for those tasks).
